dal-tadka.dish: Dal Tadka (an Indian yellow lentil dal with a spiced butter topping)
dal-tadka.finished_look: a shallow bowl of creamy, spoonable golden mung dal with a glossy red-orange swirl of spiced ghee poured over the top
dal-tadka.hero: soft golden lentils, a pool of red chile ghee, and crisp golden slices of fried garlic and onion
dal-tadka.texture: a creamy, slightly loose surface with shiny pools of spiced fat
dal-tadka.colours: turmeric gold, red-orange chile oil, deep green cilantro and curry leaves, dark mustard seeds
dal-tadka.vessel: a wide white ceramic bowl with a thin slate blue rim
dal-tadka.garnish: chopped cilantro, a few fried curry leaves, two broken dried red chiles, and cumin and black mustard seeds
dal-tadka.props: a lemon wedge and a small pile of cumin seeds
dal-tadka.raw_ingredients: yellow mung lentils, a halved tomato, garlic cloves, dried red chiles, a small mound of turmeric, a lemon half and a sprig of cilantro
dal-tadka.setting: simple Indian home cooking, warm and everyday
dal-tadka.moment: a little steam rising, and the spiced ghee still sizzling where it meets the dal

beef-and-broccoli-stir-fry.finished_look: tender strips of seared sirloin and bright green broccoli tossed in a glossy dark soy and oyster sauce
beef-and-broccoli-stir-fry.hero: thin beef slices with browned edges, vivid green broccoli florets with a little char, and slivered scallion greens
beef-and-broccoli-stir-fry.texture: a glossy sauce that lightly coats everything without being gloopy
beef-and-broccoli-stir-fry.colours: deep mahogany brown, bright emerald green and a scatter of ivory sesame seeds
beef-and-broccoli-stir-fry.vessel: a shallow white serving platter with a slate blue rim, with a small bowl of white rice beside it
beef-and-broccoli-stir-fry.garnish: toasted sesame seeds and short lengths of scallion
beef-and-broccoli-stir-fry.props: apricot-orange chopsticks resting on the platter and a knob of fresh ginger
beef-and-broccoli-stir-fry.raw_ingredients: broccoli florets, a knob of ginger, garlic cloves, scallions and a small dish of soy sauce
beef-and-broccoli-stir-fry.moment: wisps of steam rising and the sauce catching the light

stevens-margs.dish: Steven's Margarita (reposado tequila, dry orange liqueur, fresh lime and a pinch of smoked salt, shaken and served on the rocks)
stevens-margs.finished_look: a cold, pale gold-green margarita in a heavy tumbler over clear ice, unsalted rim, a lime wedge on the edge
stevens-margs.hero: clear ice cubes, the cloudy pale gold-green drink and a fresh lime wedge
stevens-margs.texture: condensation beading on the cold glass and a fine froth on top from shaking
stevens-margs.colours: pale gold-green, bright lime green, clear ice and a hint of amber from the reposado
stevens-margs.garnish: one lime wedge on the rim
stevens-margs.props: a halved lime and a small slate blue dish of flaky smoked salt
stevens-margs.raw_ingredients: whole and halved limes, a small bowl of flaky smoked salt, a metal jigger and a twist of orange peel
stevens-margs.moment: condensation running down the glass and light glowing through the drink
